retrievalProfile.description: A weathered, rustic layout featuring a male subject in casual attire against a textured industrial backdrop with heavy, distressed sans-serif typography and a central ribbon banner.
excludeWhen: high-fashion or luxury aesthetics are requested
bright neon color palettes are specified

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a baseball cap and henley shirt, leaning against a textured wall. The composition is split between the subject on the right and a large, distressed typographic block on the left, unified by a heavy teal and ochre grunge texture overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the right
Large-scale typography anchored to the top-left
Horizontal ribbon banner intersecting the primary text
Heavy grit and scratch textures applied across all layers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold name text in the upper left corner acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold name on the left, follow the horizontal banner across, and settle on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the background is filled with industrial textures and color washes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and muted blue washes in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and tan tones in the skin, hat, and wall.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal/black of the shirt providing a solid base.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in texture; values are mid-toned with heavy vignetting.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy distressing and erosion on edges
Slight upward shear/slant on the main name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are clipped and weathered to look like old woodblock or stencil prints.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold sans-serif for the name paired with an extra-condensed sans-serif for the title inside a graphic banner.
graphicDevices: Folded ribbon banner with teal fill and white border

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Good for the subtitle text within the banner.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a baseball cap and black henley shirt leaning against a weathered industrial wall. Apply a heavy teal and ochre grunge texture with scratches and film grain across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, distressed, condensed sans-serif text in the top left, slanted upwards. Place a teal ribbon banner across the middle of the text and add a secondary condensed font inside the banner.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistent across both text and image?
Is the text slanted at a consistent angle?
Does the ribbon banner appear to sit between the two lines of the main name?
Is the color palette limited to teal, tan, and charcoal?

mustAchieve: Balanced integration of subject and text
avoid: Generic 'grunge' filters that look like digital noise

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text looks physically part of the weathered surface.
Ensure the subject's face is not obscured by heavy text elements.
Verify the ribbon banner has a 3D folded appearance.
Confirm the color grading unifies the subject and the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured industrial portrait with a heavy, slanted typographic block and a central graphic banner, all unified by a consistent grit-and-grain overlay.
